description: Canonical field registry for the UniversalObservationEnvelope (Envelope B), the server-side observation model that every ingress adapter builds and the universal ingestion gateway validates (SDK + Universal Ingestion Alignment blueprint Point 2 / Invariant #1). The tree below is the blueprint's §3 envelope structure made machine-readable: blocks with their fields, requiredness, and the committed vocabularies they reference. The Python runtime model (Backend Architecture/aether-backend/shared/observation/envelope.py) and the passive TypeScript contract type (packages/shared/observation-envelope.ts) are bound to this registry by scripts/tests/contracts/test_observation_envelope_parity.py so the three cannot drift.

naming_resolutions.note: The blueprint uses inconsistent names across sections for the same concept. WS-A5 resolves every reference to the §3 Envelope-B block name and records the resolution here; WS-B adapters and the gateway consume these names.
naming_resolutions.source_native_id: source-native record identifier (§3 block name). §9 source_native_record_id, §12 source_native_event_id and §5 extract_source_id() resolve to this.
naming_resolutions.subjects[]: §3 fields identifier_type/identifier_value/actor_role/trust_class. §6 SubjectHint (identifier_type/value/namespace/role/verification_hint?/source) is a superset; the optional namespace/verification_hint/source are accepted on SubjectRef.
naming_resolutions.signature_status: signature disposition (§3). §9 signature_state resolves to this.
naming_resolutions.adapter: adapter identity (§3). §9 adapter_id resolves to this; adapter_version is separate.
naming_resolutions.occurred_at: canonical occurrence time lives under observation; temporal.source_time is the raw source-clock claim the adapter saw.
naming_resolutions.subject.trust_class: uses the field-authority trust-class vocabulary (event-registry trustClasses, OBSERVED..OPERATOR_ASSERTED); provenance.source_trust and source-trust classification use the §11 ingress credential classes.

blocks.name: observation
blocks.description: Envelope identity + occurrence/receipt/ingest times + schema version. Created by the adapter from source claims and server receipt stamps.

blocks.name: tenancy
blocks.description: Tenant provenance (Invariant #6). Every observation carries tenant identity.

blocks.name: source
blocks.description: Ingress source provenance (Invariant #7): which adapter/path/provider observed this.

blocks.name: subjects
blocks.description: Entities the observation is about (anonymous_id/user_id/account_id/...). Each subject is an identifier + actor role + field-authority trust class.

blocks.name: temporal
blocks.description: Source-clock evidence (Invariant #11). Raw source time/timezone/clock claims; never discarded during normalization.

blocks.name: correlation
blocks.description: Correlation context (Invariant #12). Canonical correlation is additive — source-native correlation values are never overwritten during normalization.

blocks.name: privacy
blocks.description: Consent + privacy policy evidence (Invariant #9). Consent snapshot / applicable purposes / GPC / DNT / policy decisions. Stamped by the gateway; never trusted from the source.

blocks.name: provenance
blocks.description: Ingress trust evidence: credential class, signature disposition, and the adapter that built this envelope.

blocks.name: quality
blocks.description: Validation/quality state assigned by the gateway (Invariant #10): raw vs normalized distinguishable, degraded dispositions never collapsed.

blocks.name: lineage
blocks.description: Evidence lineage back to the raw record (Invariant #14 / blueprint §9): raw_record_ref points at the durable Bronze raw store.

passthrough_blocks.note: Blueprint §3 lists acquisition/application/surface/device/network/payload as Envelope-B blocks but gives them no sub-tree; the committed A-side (EventContext / AcquisitionEvidence in packages/shared/events.ts) already carries that vocabulary. WS-A5 does not re-declare their fields (that would invent shape). The runtime model accepts each as an opaque passthrough of the adapter-supplied A-side-shaped sub-envelope; WS-B adapters map them and WS-A6/WSA7 may re-declare them on the spine.

trust_classes.note: Field-authority trust classes are owned by event-registry.json (trustClasses, OBSERVED..OPERATOR_ASSERTED). The envelope model validates subject.trust_class against that 10-class rank; the parity test asserts the model's local frozenset equals generated_registry.TRUST_CLASS_ORDER so the vocabulary never drifts.

purpose_ref.note: privacy.purposes reference the consent-registry purpose ids.
